mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_COMMUNITY_FREEBOARD (ID,USER_ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, USEYN, NOTICE_FLAG,CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{subject},#{content},#{useYn},#{noticeFlag},)
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_COMMUNITY_FREEBOARD as C left join op_manager as A on C.user_id = A.user_id left join g_locgov as G on G.locgov_code = A.locgov_code
AND G.locgov_code = #{shLocgovCode}
AND C.updated_date BETWEEN #{shCntrDeStart} AND DATE_ADD( #{shCntrDeEnd}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND C.is_delete = 'N'
order by C.created_date DESC;

SELECT A.id ,A.user_id ,A.subject ,A.content ,A.useyn ,A.is_delete ,A.notice_flag ,A.hits ,A.created_date ,A.updated_date ,A.user_name AS USER_NAME ,A.locgov_nm ,A.upper_locgov_nm FROM ( SELECT c.id ,c.user_id ,c.subject ,c.content ,c.useyn ,c.is_delete ,c.notice_flag ,c.hits ,c.created_date ,c.updated_date ,A.user_name ,CASE WHEN A.locgov_code IS NOT NULL THEN G.locgov_nm ELSE NULL END AS locgov_nm ,CASE WHEN A.locgov_code IS NOT NULL THEN G.upper_locgov_nm ELSE NULL END AS upper_locgov_nm FROM OP_COMMUNITY_FREEBOARD as c LEFT JOIN op_manager as A ON C.user_id = A.user_id LEFT JOIN g_locgov as G ON G.locgov_code = A.locgov_code
AND G.locgov_code = #{shLocgovCode}
AND c.updated_date BETWEEN #{shCntrDeStart} AND DATE_ADD( #{shCntrDeEnd}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND c.is_delete = 'N'
order by c.created_date DESC ) A

SELECT A.id ,A.user_id ,A.subject ,A.content ,A.useyn ,A.is_delete ,A.notice_flag ,A.hits ,A.created_date ,A.updated_date ,A.user_name AS USER_NAME ,A.locgov_nm ,A.upper_locgov_nm FROM ( SELECT c.id ,c.user_id ,c.subject ,c.content ,c.useyn ,c.is_delete ,c.notice_flag ,c.hits ,c.created_date ,c.updated_date ,a.user_name ,CASE WHEN A.locgov_code IS NOT NULL THEN g.locgov_nm ELSE NULL END AS locgov_nm ,CASE WHEN A.locgov_code IS NOT NULL THEN g.upper_locgov_nm ELSE NULL END AS upper_locgov_nm FROM op_community_freeboard as c LEFT JOIN op_manager as a ON c.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN g_locgov as g ON g.locgov_code = a.locgov_code WHERE c.id = #{id} ) A
mapper.update: update op_community_freeboard set subject = #{subject}, content = #{content}, UPDATED_DATE = where id = #{id}
